correctness.rationale: The four rows of \(U\) have leverage \(1/2\) and split into two orthogonal rank-one projectors; coupled independent fair Bernoulli samples give independent \(\operatorname{Bin}(2\nu,1/2)\) counts. Exact covariance/variance ratios for every entry equal \((h+\ell)/2\). The two corrected and raw eigenvalues, exact failure probabilities, strict boundary at \(\kappa=3\), fusion threshold \(\theta>(\kappa-3)/2\), and the two Frobenius risks follow from this decomposition. The Gaussian limit and fixed-contrast large-deviation exponent follow from standard binomial limit theorems; no finite enumeration is used to certify an infinite identity. The companion rational verifier independently assembled all outcomes in five configurations and completed 18,761 checks. Remaining scope is explicitly restricted to the model.

value.rationale: The exact quantitative loss of positive definiteness is significant because Galerkin reduced operators require stable inversion and a forward/inverse fusion uses a positive-definite cone. The result shows strict Frobenius variance improvement coexisting with an exact 1/3 conditional one-sketch failure, an all-count coefficient-contrast threshold, and a nonuniform \(\kappa\asymp\sqrt{\nu}\) sample-complexity transition. The variance-ratio ridge obstruction supplies a motivated sharp design diagnostic, rather than an arbitrary matrix example; generic qualitative instability was already known and is not presented as new.
